title: WhatsApp to calendar, live
lead: A lead writes on WhatsApp. The system captures the details, stores the record, drafts a reply for approval and books the appointment.
w0: Press Watch it run to follow one lead from first message to booked appointment.
w3: The system captures her name, what she wants and the date.
w5: A reply is drafted. It waits for your approval.
w6: You approved it. The reply is sent and Sofía picks a time.
w7: The appointment is booked and Sofía gets a confirmation.
done_static: Finished: one lead, from first message to booked appointment.
msg_1: Hi, I'm interested in installing internet on the 15th of September.
reply: Hi Sofía! Thanks for reaching out. We can schedule your installation for Tuesday, 15 September. Does 10:00 AM or 2:00 PM work better for you?
confirm: You're booked: Tuesday, 15 September at 10:00 AM. See you then.
